heroDescription: All essential information for OTTO Work Force employees working at Rhenus Poznan.
absenceImportantText: Use the form to report absence, lateness or any other attendance issue.
absenceRules: Report your absence as early as possible.
Do not wait until the start of the shift.
In case of sick leave, inform your consultant as well.
Use a separate form for each absence.
absenceInstructions: Wait for consultant feedback after submission.
absenceNorms: 4 or more absences (NNK) – termination may be considered. Supporting documents (L4 or another document) are required.
Sick leave (L4) removes standards and monthly bonus eligibility.
myOttoDescription: Through myOTTO employees can check salary, taxes, documents and notifications.
myOttoLogin: The first login credentials are provided by the coordinator. Employees set their own password afterwards.
redShirt: Red T-shirts are required at work.
absenceNotice: All absences must be reported to the coordinator.
vacationNotice: Vacation requests should be submitted at least one week in advance.
salaryInfo: Salary is paid to a bank account by the 15th of the month.
advanceInfo: During the first month of employment employees may request an advance up to 500 PLN gross.
officeAutoReply: After the automated message starts, select option 1.
footerDeveloped: Developed by Yuliya Masechko for Rhenus Poznan Project
vacationNormInfoText: Employees working under a mandate contract (Umowa zlecenia) are not entitled to paid annual leave (urlop wypoczynkowy), but may arrange unpaid days off (days without shifts) in advance according to warehouse rules.
vacationImportantText: Due to the significant increase in the number of employees, new rules for requesting days off have been introduced. Absence from a shift without an approved request is treated as an unexcused absence.
vacationRules: Day off requests are accepted only through the official form.
The form must be submitted by 1:00 PM Monday to Friday.
Requests submitted after 1:00 PM or sent privately to consultants will not be accepted.
Requests for distant dates may be approved later — requests for the nearest dates are processed first.
Please plan your days off in advance.
Requests submitted one day before the planned day off are allowed only in exceptional cases.
New employees and rehired employees cannot request days off during their first month of employment.
Days off under Umowa zlecenia are unpaid and valid only after approval.
vacationInstructions: Enter POZ and your 4-digit employee number without spaces in the POZ field (e.g., POZ1234).
Enter your first and last name exactly as in your passport using the Latin alphabet.
If you need only one day off, select the same date twice.
If you make a mistake, contact your consultant.
Do not submit duplicate requests for the same period.
In case of sudden illness or emergency, use the «Report Urgent Absence» button.
